# Support

## Response times

Issues are monitored on weekdays. Weekend issues are not handled unless urgent (crash on launch, data loss, security).

If your issue is urgent, start the title with **URGENT** and briefly explain why in the description.

## Before opening an issue

- Check the [existing issues](https://github.com/omertahaoztop/omp-orchestrator/issues) for duplicates.
- Make sure you are on the [latest release](https://github.com/omertahaoztop/omp-orchestrator/releases).
- If the problem is in the Pi agent itself (not the GUI), report it [upstream](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues).
